findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The nozzle on the horchata refresher was observed soiled. The PIC was made aware. The nozzle was removed, cleaned, and sanitized. Ensure that food contact surfaces are monitored, cleaned, and sanitized at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The. Quaternary ammonia sanitizer in the sani bucket was observed reading between 100-0 ppm. The PIC was notified and the sani bucket was remade. Ensure that the concentration of the sani bucket is routinely checked.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following were observed. 
1. The caulking on the utility sink was observed loose and in a state of disrepair. 
2. The coving tiles on the wall behind the soda syrups and the wall behind he fryers was observed coming off the wall.

Discussed with the PIC. The PIC assured inspector that the relevant repairs will be done. Ensure that the corrective actions for the areas mentioned above are taken.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed  employee not using a barrier to shut the faucet after washing their hands. Discussed with PIC and the behavior was corrected. Ensure that staff are knowledgeable to used a barrier to shut off the faucet after washing their hands to avoid recontaminating their hands.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(B) Cleaning Procedure. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use the following cleaning procedure in the order stated to clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms, including surrogate prosthetic devices for hands and arms: (1) Rinse under clean, running warm water; (2) Apply an amount of cleaning compound recommended by the cleaning compound manufacturer; (3) Rub together vigorously for at least 10 to 15 seconds while: (a) Paying particular attention to removing soil from underneath the fingernails during the cleaning procedure, and (b) Creating friction on the surfaces of the hands and arms or surrogate prosthetic devices for hands and arms, finger tips, and areas between the fingers; (4) Thoroughly rinse under clean, running warm water; and (5) Immediately follow the cleaning procedure with thorough drying using a method as specified under § 6-301.12.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The gasket of the walk-in freezer door is observed in the state of disrepair which is allowing cold air to leave the freezer and for warm air to enter the freezer that may result in ice accumulation. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspector that a ticket has already been put in for the relevant repairs. Ensure that the gasket is repair to allow the door to seal properly to void ice accumulation and other potential hazards.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: At the start of the inspection, there was a soiled spatula placed behind the faucet of the hand sink. This spatula was removed from this location and placed into the triple sink to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized. Ensure the hand sink is only used for hand washing.  
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The walk-in freezer door is observed to have an accumulation of ice on the inside of the door. Ensure this ice is removed to allow the door to close properly and to ensure that the surface remains easily cleanable. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The gasket of the walk-in freezer is observed to be in a state of disrepair which is allowing for cold air to leave the freezer and for warm air to enter the freezer resulting in ice accumulation. Ensure once the ice is removed that the door/gasket is repaired to allow the door to seal properly and to maintain the door to be easily cleanable. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
